$comment: Schema for protocol/service_actions.canonical.json -- Stage 5's hand-authored, evidence-based canonical model of the 8 official V1.1 write-only (access=W) service commands at 0x1600-0x1612. Deliberately NOT part of registers.canonical.json: a service action has no read_function, no poll_group/freshness_budget_s, and no readback (it is ACK-only by protocol design, per the manifest's own readback_rule field) -- forcing it through the register schema (which assumes a polled read/write field with a freshness budget) would be exactly the kind of schema-weakening this Stage's own directive forbids. Validated by tools/protocol/lib/mini-schema.js (structural shape only) PLUS a separate semantic-invariant pass in tools/protocol/generate_stage5_service_actions.js (cross-field rules mini-schema cannot express, e.g. 'payload_bytes == word_count*2', 'blocked rows must not carry a resolved payload_value_contract') -- see that generator's own module comment for the full semantic rule list.

manifest_id.description: the exact V1.1 manifest name_prog, e.g. VoltageCalibration -- for evidence cross-referencing

declared_access.description: always 'w' for this file -- a service action is never r/rw; that would belong in registers.canonical.json instead

read_function.description: always null -- a write-only service command has no Modbus read function by definition

write_function.description: null only when the write mechanism itself is not yet unambiguously established (must match a real open blocker)

poll_group.description: always null -- never polled, never enters the read plan

freshness_budget_s.description: always null -- meaningless for a field that is never read back

readback_rule.description: the ONLY readback rule this file may ever declare -- a service action is confirmed by ACK alone, per the V1.1 manifest's own readback_rule for every one of these 8 rows

word_count.description: number of 16-bit Modbus holding registers this command's payload spans. null when the primary source itself is internally inconsistent about width (e.g. VoltageCalibration/CurrentCalibration: typed UINT16 but declared Length=4 bytes in the same official PDF) -- never resolved by guessing.

payload_bytes.description: must equal word_count*2 whenever both are non-null (enforced by the generator's semantic pass, not by this structural schema)

payload_parameterized.description: true if the command takes a real caller-supplied value (e.g. Timecalibration's timestamp); false if it is a fixed-payload trigger (e.g. Shutdown) -- independent of whether that payload's exact value is yet established

payload_value_contract.description: a precise, source-cited description of the EXACT bytes/value this command writes (not merely its wire type/length). null means the exact value is NOT established by any local authoritative source -- the command MUST then have implementation_state=blocked with blocked_reason=PAYLOAD_VALUE_CONTRACT_NOT_ESTABLISHED (enforced by the generator's semantic pass).

blocked_reason.description: required (non-null) when implementation_state=blocked; must be null when implementation_state=service-action-software-ready (enforced by the generator's semantic pass, not expressible in mini-schema alone)

blocker_closure_criterion.description: required (non-null) when implementation_state=blocked; must be null when implementation_state=service-action-software-ready
